tasks.name: Force regulation — low setpoint
tasks.gate: reach_offset moved negative (force-regulated back-off)

tasks.name: Sensor-cut ablation — reach_offset delta
tasks.gate: Δ > 0.03 m proves sensor drives controller

tasks.name: Force regulation RMSE
tasks.gate: 0 < RMSE < 0.05 m (regulated, non-trivial)

tasks.name: Door opening — hinge angle
tasks.gate: door_angle ≥ 1.0 rad (measured from qpos, not commanded)

tasks.name: 3-finger force-closure grasp
tasks.gate: HOLDING state, grip_cmd ≥ 0.9 rad

tasks.name: Slip reflex ≤ 4 ms
tasks.gate: grip_cmd non-decreasing within 2 steps of slip

tasks.name: Ferrari-Canny grasp quality
tasks.gate: n_contacts ≥ 1 (force-closure measured)

tasks.name: Carry stability (bottle-hand proximity)
tasks.gate: bottle stays within 0.5 m of hand during CARRY

tasks.name: Shelf placement success
tasks.gate: place_success = True (measured from bottle-shelf distance)

tasks.name: Balance — no falls during episode
tasks.gate: fall_count = 0

tasks.name: Energy conservation < 1%
tasks.gate: std/mean < 1% over 1000 steps

tasks.name: All 8 FSM states reachable (incl. REORIENT)
tasks.gate: all 8 states visited in one episode

tasks.name: Friction-cone slip margin (mu*fn - |ft|)
tasks.gate: friction-cone margin computed from live mj_contactForce reads

tasks.name: In-hand reorientation (wrist yaw 90°)
tasks.gate: reorient_success=True, wrist F/T monitored throughout

tasks.name: Domain randomization — 10-seed sweep
tasks.gate: grasp+place success ≥ 8/10 randomized physics seeds

tasks.name: Wrist F/T non-zero during CARRY
tasks.gate: wrist F/T > 0.01 N for > 50% of CARRY samples

tasks.name: Bilateral foot force sensors active
tasks.gate: both foot sensors > 0.1 N for > 30% of samples

tasks.name: IMU sensor liveness (gyro + accel vary)
tasks.gate: gyro and accel std > 0 over 500 steps

tasks.name: mj_contactForce cross-validates touch_palm
tasks.gate: mj_contactForce and touch_palm agree on contact state

tasks.name: Wrist F/T non-zero during in-hand REORIENT
tasks.gate: wrist F/T > 0.01 N for > 50% of REORIENT phase
